brief: Complete the outstanding remedial work for the cooling stage cycling intermittently and the conservator level low before the heat event begins, as required by SOP-016. Because the cooling system is ONAN and cooling is degraded, reduce the permissible load to the ONAN rating per SOP-016 and apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure for this ageing unit under MG-023. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period in accordance with MG-021.
